name: shipproof
description: Model-independent acceptance contracts and tamper-aware evidence for AI coding agents.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/make-cli-executable.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.action.json && node scripts/set-package-type.mjs action-build commonjs && ncc build action-build/action.js -o action-dist --minify && node scripts/set-package-type.mjs action-dist commonjs
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && node dist/cli.js benchmark
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
